conf.description: Trellix ePO DLP Endpoint incident, api-pull: REST Collector against the DLP 11.10+ incident-detail API. Response property names are undocumented outside a client-side portal this map's research could not read, so field-level ECS mapping is deliberately NOT implemented here - see README gap.

conf.comment: Field names unknown - work order fields[] is empty by design, not an oversight. Do not guess: onboard the real inventory from a captured live response and then apply the jdbc-sql pipeline's normalization branch (same severity/action/domain-split logic) to it. This pipeline only unwraps JSON and tags dataset/transport.

functions.description: document why no field-level mapping exists on this format
generically unpack the incident-detail JSON body so its (currently unknown) properties become addressable fields, without inventing any of their names
tag dataset and collection transport - the only fields this pipeline can safely set without guessing the API's property names
